items.html: And that lock of hairs of the head of Arich Anpin, drawn along the back from outside, spreads downward and touches the head itself of ZA, which clothes the NHY of Aba and Ima and Arich Anpin itself; for the body of Arich Anpin is within, inside all of them, and ZA does not stick to or touch it at all. And those hairs of Arich Anpin are channels and springs that draw influence and great light from the Moach Stimaa within it, downward into ZA; and those illuminations come out through the mouths of the hairs, to the outside, at the place of their ending below.
